kdc_config_file.description: Path to the KDC configuration file.

kdc_enabled.description: Whether to start the Heimdal KDC daemon.

kpasswdd_enabled.description: Whether to start the Heimdal kpasswdd (password change) daemon.

master_enabled.description: Whether this host is the KDC master (used for iprop replication).

slave_enabled.description: Whether this host is a KDC slave (for iprop replication).

slave_params.description: Additional parameters for the KDC slave (e.g., master hostname for iprop).
